foreground.description: Short description of the main subjects visible in the foreground.

background.description: Short description of the background, environment, distant subjects and setting.

lighting.description: Short description of the illumination conditions, including light source, intensity, direction and shadows.

weather.description: Short description of atmospheric and weather conditions.

cars.description: Cars visible in the image. Use an empty array if no cars are visible.

visibility.description: Description of the car's visibility, considering both occlusion and truncation.
